title: Explorer 1 launched on Imbolc

tellings.quote: Over 20 years later, Explorer 1, the first US satellite built by JPL, was launched on January 31st, 1958.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points out that Explorer 1, the first American satellite, built by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, a NASA space lab, was launched on January 31st, 1958. He links the date to Imbolc, an old pagan festival at the start of February, as part of his idea that the space programme timed things to match ancient rituals.
